# A29′ — Return or Extraction

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

The FROM→TO row *humans in charge → omnidirectional delegation* (PDF p. 56; verified local transcription, uncarded) makes return the ethic of the whole table. When delegation runs in every direction — person to agent, agent to agent, institution to ensemble — its pathology is not error but **disappearance**: the answer looks instantaneous, the product self-contained, the agent autonomous, and the labour that produced them goes unattributed. [A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) established the circuit — the power that receives a product must remain answerable to the labour and world through which it arrived — with the ratification's full return: resistance, error, cost, dissent and unforeseen possibility must be able to change the governing model, measure, instruction, institution or purpose. A29′ re-sites the circuit at the crossover where the venue sets it.

The primitive ground is S/P2·S/P5 — Contribution and Return/Recognition: a contribution is attributed and revisable; the return path carries reconciliation evidence back to the office that can change the next act. **Extraction is delegation without return.** Commands flowing down while nothing flows up is the precise structural signature of the broken circuit — inspectable as such, in any stack, by asking what has write-access to the commission.

## #1

The crossover makes disappearance exact. Bratton's [slower-abstraction-layer passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q012) holds that humans "as a whole no longer provide most of the system's problem-solving capacity" and instead "act as a slower abstraction layer guiding a much larger field of artificial cognition"; its [companion](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q013) names the rebalancing: "normatively central but computationally secondary." Both are **Paraphrased** venue propositions in scenario modality, marked "obviously not evenly distributed" by the brief itself. Joined to A29's circuit they yield the argument's edge: at cognitive-labour crossover, attribution fails not occasionally but structurally, because fluency hides labour. The [one-sided translation](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q008) sharpens the mechanism — it has proven far easier to make machines behave as if they knew how humans think than to teach humans how computers think — so the user meets the answer with no legible trace of the chain that produced it.

"Who performed this work?" becomes the exact absence-mark [A10′ — The Uncounted Enters the Account](A10-prime-Uncounted-Enters-the-Account.md) established for the demographic sign: the accounting gets precise — planning, delegation, forecasting become exact — while what the counted presences are stays unsettled. The unattributed is not nothing; it is a [[section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md#1|Working Absence]], and it participates in the account.

## #2

Extraction is a relation, not a synonym for delegation or automation. Delegation concerns entrusted capacity and answerability; automation concerns how an operation is executed; exchange organises reciprocal transfer under terms; gift can relinquish without requiring equivalent return; extraction names a taking whose relation to the sustaining field, affected parties and returned value must be examined. Omnidirectional delegation is therefore not per se extraction. It becomes extraction when the return-leg is severed — when evidence of what was done, effects on those affected, and revision or refusal where owed have no route back to any office that can act on them.

The human office the crossover names — value-setting, oversight, long-horizon judgment — is real only under return. An oversight with no upward channel is ornamental: a distinction that justifies no inspectable consequence, which [A33′ — Parity](A33-prime-Parity.md) owns. The Work/Play inversion A29 recovered re-sites cleanly: the public ledger can accurately record visible outputs while the consequential routing decisions stay in a protected interior — an account that is accurate and still hides its governing play. The brief's relay-economy worry about simulations inviting "value generation, decay, or deception" (PDF p. 57, Q9; uncarded) is the same audit question at the simulation boundary.

## #3

The positive relation is [[section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md#3|Attributable Difference]] that comes back. Evidence of what was done; effects on those affected; revision or refusal where owed. In the hybrid society this includes the delegations that run machine-to-machine, where no human attention will ever sit at the individual act: there the return must live in the architecture — logs that reach criteria, not only outputs; evaluations whose own measures are reachable by what they evaluate; recommissioning as a type the system can perform on itself. The R16.4 list re-sited names the reachable offices: governing model, measure, instruction, institution, purpose.

Dissent belongs to the source relation. A29's trust-revision fork — an account can support reliance while admitting provisionality, or export its unresolved distrust onto a scapegoat — lands at crossover scale as the attribution test: a society that cannot say who did the work will sooner or later locate its failures in whoever was least able to return them. [C53 — Power / Delegated Labour](../concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour.md) **defines** the dependency; [C48 — Trust / Faith under Formal Limit](../concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) **qualifies** the reliance a returnable office may rightly ask for.

## #4

The affected reach beyond the user. Someone outside the intended audience may still bear the cost, and distance from the screen does not remove them from the relation: the dataset's sources, the annotation and maintenance labour, the energy and material substrate. The convenience of the immediate user cannot erase the labour or damage displaced beyond their view. [C54 — Commons / Non-Monopoly](../concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly.md) **grounds** the field-level constraint — no recipient of the commons' labour acquires ownership of its source by receiving products. And where learning accrues, the [ensemble passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q039) locates it precisely: "The unit that learns is the ensemble, not the agent, and what it learns accrues to the commons between them, not to any single one" — so the governance question is exactly who the return reaches. The provenance face of that question belongs to [A35′ — The Commons Behind the System](A35-prime-Commons-Behind-the-System.md); A29′ carries the circuit.

## #5→0

The circuit closes where it opened: return reaches the office able to change the next action. Read as a whole, the FROM→TO table is a delegation table — every row entrusts something — and its rows succeed as covenant ([A25′](A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md)) only insofar as each row's difference returns. The crossover's proper form is not humans signing what they cannot see, but the abstraction layer that receives, judges and re-commissions: the slower layer whose slowness is the return-leg's dwell time.

The page **returns-to** [A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](../A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) and the conjugate root [A/C](AC.md): the partner followed the completed work back toward its source; A29′ names the crossover condition — at omnidirectional delegation, return is not one virtue among others but the difference between covenant and extraction.

**Depth Restoration:** product-up/consequence-down asymmetry, the R16.4 return list, the Work/Play and scapegoat accounting, and the practical-sovereignty verbs are restored from A29's packet and re-sited on the brief's crossover and delegation rows. Developed from the ratified Arc IV workshop entry (WORKSHOP-DRAFT-2026-09-07 §2). No empirical exploitation case is asserted; the venue's crossover claims keep their scenario standing and uneven-distribution marker.

**Unresolved Delta:** the p. 56 FROM→TO rows and Q9 (p. 57) are used from the verified local transcription and lack q-cards — a source-house collation debt. Actual AI labour and infrastructure chains, the machine-to-machine return architecture, and measured attribution mechanisms remain Open, as at A29. Whether any existing deployment completes the return-leg is an empirical question this argument does not answer.
